_README_1: PASTE YOUR WEB3FORMS ACCESS KEY ABOVE, between the empty quotes on the first line.
_README_2: Get one free at https://web3forms.com — enter info@bhramanyatri.com as the email to receive submissions at, and they email you an Access Key. No password or account is needed.
_README_4: Keep the quotes and the comma exactly as they are. Only the text inside the quotes changes.
_README_5: This key is safe to keep in the website's files. It is designed to be public and cannot be used to read your email or your account.
_README_6: IMPORTANT: the address that receives enquiries is the one you type on the Web3Forms website when creating the key. The 'recipientEmail' line above is only a reminder of which address that should be; changing it here does NOT change where email goes.
_README_7: While the key is empty, the Contact and Enquiry forms show an error telling the visitor to email or WhatsApp instead. They never falsely claim a message was sent.
_README_8: After changing this, the website must be published again ('deploy') for it to take effect.
_README_9: Full instructions are in the file README.md, in this same folder.
